modalities.evidence: A 1 mm resolution MPRAGE structural scan was also collected
FMRI data were collected across twelve runs
All participants engaged with twelve cognitive tasks

output.population: Sixty adults (35 females, mean age 22.95, range 18-38 years of age) with normal hearing and corrected to normal vision, recruited from the University of Western Ontario and surrounding area
output.summary: Structural MRI and task fMRI collected while adults performed twelve cognitive tasks measuring planning, reasoning, attention and working memory, supporting a network sampling account of human intelligence.
